generic_sampling_rules.build_order: Finalize each table completely before its dependents: (1) sample free columns, (2) apply per-column exceptions/forced literals, (3) sample fresh PK/UNIQUE values, (4) deduplicate unique tuples, (5) apply group-size/tie targets, (6) apply semantic rules that touch non-key columns only, (7) apply null rule, (8) MATERIALIZE immutable final key tuple set. Children then sample FKs exclusively from the parent's materialized final key tuples. No parent-side mutation may occur after child FK fill; if a parent is ever touched post-hoc, re-run child FK fill.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential unique integers within [1, 230]; never NULL. For PKs that are also FKs (Students.student_id, Candidates.candidate_id), values are taken exclusively from the parent's materialized key pool (copied), never generated fresh.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from the parent table's MATERIALIZED final key tuples (after dedup, group-size, tie, semantic and null rules); coerce to child's declared type (VARCHAR parent -> INTEGER child via CAST); never NULL for NOT NULL FK columns; fail loudly if parent pool is empty.
generic_sampling_rules.composite_fk: Sample the joint tuple from the parent's MATERIALIZED final composite key tuples; never sample composite-FK columns independently.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_measure_or_flag: Random integer in observed range; flags drawn from {0,1}.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_name_or_text: Random word string length 3-30 using letters/spaces; near-variants (case changes) inserted when an equality/LIKE pattern is targeted.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_phone: Random phone format matching observed styles (digits, parens, x-extension, dots, hyphens).
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_char_small: Random short uppercase letter string length 1-3 within CHAR length.
generic_sampling_rules.literal_injection: For every per_column_exceptions entry with explicit numeric 'values' on a NON-FK column, force at least one generated row per listed literal and one step on each side of each numeric boundary. For entries listed as 'inject_into_parent', inject the literal into the PARENT primary key stream before the parent is finalized; children then FK-fill from the parent's final set. FK columns are never force-overwritten with values outside the parent's final key set.
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: Only columns listed in null_targets receive planted NULLs; every other nullable column is always non-NULL. Each null_target column gets at least one NULL per instance and a share matching spec_share (compact database's share, default 0.10-0.20 when unknown). NOT NULL/PK/FK/UNIQUE columns never get NULL. Planted NULLs are never replaced.
